source: BK4 printed p.77 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.83; ERRATA ER-23 (prose only)
note: ER-23 is prose only (M10 is the end-around-carry junction for Experiment 7); it changes no wire, so wires = as_printed. The page prints one worked example: enter 4 (100) on the slide switches, 5 (101) on pushbuttons 4 and 6, and the step-3 example reading is lights 3 and 6 ON, 4 and 5 OFF = 1001 (9). The expect pairs the step-1/2 example inputs with the step-3 example reading; the page does not print any other sum. The 500 ms advance before the expect lets the output lamps finish their thermal transients; the page states no timing.

script.cite: BK4 printed p.77 procedure steps 1-3 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.83
script.quote: to enter binary 4 (100) set slide switch 4 LEFT, slide switch 5 RIGHT and slide switch 6 RIGHT. ... to enter binary 5 (101) push button 4 and 6; do not push pushbutton 5. ... The answer will be displayed in binary output lights 3, 4, 5 and 6. For example, if lights 3 and 6 are ON and lights 4 and 5 are OFF, the answer is 1001 (9).
